gloss: plot of land; landed property; premises

definitions.gloss: plot of land; landed property; estate
definitions.explanation: A piece of land, especially one owned as property — a lot, plot, or estate. Somewhat formal; emphasizes land as a possession or asset.

examples.japanese: ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧{地所|じしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{所有|しょゆう}→所有：12752_shoyuu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He owns a large plot of land.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{地所|じしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{先祖代々|せんぞだいだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧だ。
examples.english: That plot of land has been in the family for generations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地所|じしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}い{取|と}って→買い取る：16704_kaitoru⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: The company bought up a plot of land in front of the station and put up a new building.

notes:
A piece of land held as property — a lot, plot, or estate. Somewhat formal; emphasizes land as a possession or asset.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地所|じしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{所有|しょゆう}→所有：12752_shoyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to own a piece of land
- ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧{地所|じしょ}: a large plot of land

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧: land — the everyday, general word
- ⟦{敷地|しきち}→敷地：00365_shikichi⟧: site; premises — land set aside for a specific building or use
